verdict.rationale: Docs confirm core forwarding/consolidation workflow: mail and packages can be viewed, opened/scanned, forwarded domestically or internationally, shredded, or picked up on a scheduled basis, all managed remotely via app/web — directly matching the digital-nomad forwarding/hold/pickup story. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation of acceptance from 'all major carriers' (UPS/FedEx/DHL/USPS) and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
